stock.description: Win Hanverky Holdings Limited, a subsidiary of Quinta Asia Limited, operates as a global enterprise primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of sportswear, outerwear, fashion apparel, and related accessories. The company's reach extends across Mainland China, Europe, various other Asian nations, the United States, Hong Kong, and Canada. Its business is structured into two main divisions: Manufacturing and High-end Fashion Retailing. In addition to producing goods, Win Hanverky manages an extensive network of high-end fashion retail outlets. This network encompasses proprietary store concepts like D-mop and J-01, as well as brands for which it holds distribution rights, including Y-3, Thomas Sabo, Tara Jarmon, and Heron Preston. The company also operates licensed stores under well-known names such as Champion, DAKS, and New Era. By December 31, 2021, its retail presence included 264 stores globally, with 228 located in Mainland China, 26 across Hong Kong and Macau, and 10 in Taiwan and Singapore. Furthermore, Win Hanverky Holdings Limited holds property assets. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
